name: angled_bracket
description: Wedge bracket: flat top for 30 mm, then a straight slope down to 15 mm at the right end. 2x Ø6 vertical holes in the flat part, Ø8 cross hole through the low end.

low_h.description: height at the right end of the slope

flat_len.description: length of the flat top from the left

hole_x.description: vertical holes from the left end

hole_inset.description: vertical holes from the front and back faces; their spacing follows as depth - 2 * hole_inset

cross_from_right.description: cross hole centre from the right end
